dedup_applied_finding: dedup-applied.json corrects the WEBALL double-count (identical TTL_INDIV_CONTRIB repeated under a chamber-switcher's House and Senate IDs). It does NOT change any pas2-derived column in this script: pas2 is transaction-level, so per-ID amounts differ and there is no duplicate copy to drop — the same finding apply_dedup.py records for AIPAC/corporate. It DOES affect the weball side of the reconciliation: col 26 (OTHER_POL_CMTE_CONTRIB) is duplicated under both IDs the same way, so the reconciliation zeroes the dropped IDs' col-26 copies (guarded by the same equality check apply_dedup.py uses) and reports raw vs corrected residuals separately. No correction was invented for these columns.
